core: Chemotactic G protein-coupled signaling in leukocyte migration
qualifier: CXCR4, G beta:gamma-PI3Kgamma and prostaglandin E inputs
name: Leukocyte chemotactic GPCR signaling via CXCR4, PI3Kgamma and prostaglandin E
rationale: Members are GPCR-driven signals (PLC/PKC, Cdc42) steering dendritic cell and lymphocyte migration; CXCR4, PI3Kgamma and PGE response are what the chemokine/RHO GTPase confusables lack.

qualifier: Lewis blood group oligosaccharide synthesis
name: Fucose metabolism and Lewis antigen oligosaccharide synthesis
rationale: All members concern fucose handling and fucosylated oligosaccharide (Lewis antigen) synthesis, unlike the N-glycan, O-glycan and sialylation confusables.

qualifier: protein degradation and cristae/outer membrane organization
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing, degradation and cristae organization
rationale: Members cover targeting, import, presequence processing and turnover of mitochondrial proteins plus cristae and outer membrane organization, versus confusables on inner-membrane insertion, respiratory assembly or mitochondrial calcium.

qualifier: sodium-coupled TCA intermediates, renal proximal tubule
name: Sodium-coupled TCA-intermediate carboxylate transport, renal proximal tubule
rationale: Members are transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate-type tricarboxylates and pyruvate by sodium-coupled carriers with proximal tubule development, distinct from carnitine, malate-aspartate, lactate and organic cation confusables.

core: Th1 polarization and type II interferon production
qualifier: driven by dendritic cell IL-12/GM-CSF and MHC upregulation
name: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 and type II interferon promotion
rationale: Members positively regulate Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma production and MHC expression via dendritic cell cytokine (IL-12, GM-CSF) production, whereas confusables center on IFN-gamma receptor signaling and its negative regulation.

qualifier: type I hypersensitivity
name: Fc-epsilon receptor calcium mobilization in type I hypersensitivity
rationale: All three members describe FcERI/LAT2-driven calcium mobilization underlying type I hypersensitivity, unlike mast cell regulation, eosinophil, BCR and GPCR mediator confusables.

qualifier: with glycosphingolipid and ganglioside biosynthesis
name: Glycosphingolipid synthesis and monogenic lipid-metabolizing enzyme defects
rationale: Members are glycosphingolipid/ganglioside biosynthesis plus inherited defects of oxysterol, eicosanoid and lipid-handling enzymes or transporters (ABCB6 is an outlier), separating them from bile acid, fatty acid/eicosanoid and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

core: Resting membrane potential and cation gradient homeostasis
qualifier: two-pore-domain, KATP and calcium-activated potassium channels with Na+/K+-ATPase
name: Resting membrane potential via K2P, KATP channels and Na+/K+-ATPase
rationale: Members set membrane potential and Na+/K+/Mg2+ gradients through potassium leak, KATP and KCa channels and P-type ATPases, which the excitability, chloride cotransporter and paracellular confusables lack.

qualifier: COPI vesicle traffic
name: Golgi stack organization and COPI-mediated vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning together with COPI intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic; confusables lack either the structural Golgi organization or the COPI arm.

qualifier: neuronal migration and branchiomotor axon guidance
name: Hindbrain development, neuronal migration and branchiomotor axon guidance
rationale: Members concern brainstem/pons development, hindbrain neuron migration and branchiomotor guidance, distinct from cerebellar, spinal cord patterning and motor behavior confusables.

qualifier: nucleolar endonucleolytic cleavage
name: Nucleolar pre-rRNA endonucleolytic cleavage and processing
rationale: Members describe cleavage and maturation of the tricistronic pre-rRNA (with MYC targets and Pol I upregulation), whereas confusables center on RNA polymerase I/III transcription.

qualifier: L1 cell adhesion molecule signaling
name: L1-mediated axon tract morphogenesis and cerebellar development
rationale: Members combine L1 signaling and recycling with commissural/corticospinal tract formation and cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia development, which the midbrain, forebrain and cortical confusables lack.

qualifier: hypusine and diphthamide on translation elongation factors
name: Protein hydroxylation and hypusine/diphthamide modification of elongation factors
rationale: Members are post-translational residue modifications (prolyl/lysyl hydroxylation, hypusine on eIF5A, diphthamide on eEF2) promoting elongation, unlike tRNA modification, methylation and collagen crosslinking confusables.

qualifier: interferon-alpha effector response, OAS and IP-10
name: Cytosolic RNA/DNA sensing and interferon-alpha antiviral effector response
rationale: Members link RIG-I/helicase and DNA sensing via IRF3 to type I interferon effectors (OAS, IP-10, DC activation), whereas confusables focus on regulators of RLR signaling and IFN production.

core: Nuclear noncoding RNA processing and exosome decay
qualifier: snoRNP and telomerase RNP biogenesis, Cajal body
name: Nuclear exosome RNA decay, snoRNP and telomerase RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover exosome-mediated nuclear RNA surveillance, snoRNA/scaRNA processing and Cajal body targeting, rRNA modification and telomerase assembly, distinct from NMD, splicing/export, RNA modification and transcription confusables.

qualifier: mast cell activation and Fc-gamma phagocytosis
name: Fc receptor signaling in mast cell activation and phagocytosis
rationale: Members are FcERI and FcgammaR signaling with mast cell degranulation, hypersensitivity and phagocytosis, which the BCR-centered confusables lack.

qualifier: E2F and MYC-driven G1/S and G2/M, stimulated CD4 T cells
name: E2F- and MYC-driven G1/S and G2/M proliferation program
rationale: Members are E2F/G2M cell cycle transcription and checkpoint modules including MYC network and stimulated CD4 T cell division, versus confusables on DREAM/RB repression and replication initiation.

qualifier: neurotransmitter, incretin and fatty-acid modulation
name: Neural, incretin and fatty-acid modulation of islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members are modulators of insulin and glucagon secretion by acetylcholine, catecholamines, GLP-1 and fatty acids, unlike confusables on insulin processing, incretin synthesis and KATP channels.

qualifier: receptor engagement through SMO to GLI
name: Hedgehog receptor engagement and SMO-GLI signal transduction
rationale: Members cover Hh ligand-receptor binding, SMO activation and GLI target transcription, while confusables are Hh ligand processing or downstream developmental patterning.

qualifier: apoptotic cells, oxidized LDL and amyloid-beta by microglia/macrophages
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells, oxLDL and amyloid-beta
rationale: Members describe scavenger receptor and microglial/macrophage uptake of apoptotic cells, lipoproteins and amyloid-beta, which hyaluronan, AGE receptor and lysosome confusables lack.

qualifier: histone stem-loop processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
name: mRNA 3'-end formation, histone mRNA processing and deadenylation-dependent decay
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, SLBP histone mRNA processing, deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, distinct from capping/splicing, ARE-binding and nuclear exosome confusables.

qualifier: leukocyte and dendritic cell chemokine receptors
name: Chemokine receptor signaling in leukocyte and dendritic cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor modules and chemotaxis of T, B, NK, mast and dendritic cells, distinct from lymphoid organ homing/S1P and integrin adhesion confusables.
Members are mostly heterogeneous untitled modules (chromatin, Pol II initiation, mitochondria, ubiquitination, mitosis, growth-factor braking) with no single shared biological theme.

qualifier: social and sensorimotor-gating behavior, amygdala development
name: Social and sensorimotor-gating behavior with amygdala development
rationale: Members are complex behaviors (social interaction, prepulse inhibition, psychomotor, tactile and visual behavior) with amygdala development and MECP2-GABA regulation, unlike vocal, locomotor and synaptic confusables.

qualifier: FGF23-Klotho signaling and dentin formation
name: FGF23-Klotho phosphate signaling and dentin-bone mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c-Klotho, PTH and phosphate responses with bone mineralization, dentinogenesis, tooth eruption and secreted protein phosphorylation, which phosphate transporter and mineralization-inhibition confusables lack.
